rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#2C2A29]
rules.label: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#D4AF37]

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing. Sections should use py-24 or py-32. Containers max-w-7xl.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Use asymmetrical bento grids for Services and Portfolio. Mix large feature cards with smaller secondary cards.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Soft, subtle borders (border-[#E5E1D8]) with rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl corners.

components.nav_header: Sticky nav, crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF9F6]/80 border-b border-[#E5E1D8]/50). Logo on left, links and gold CTA on right.
components.hero: Full height or min-h-[90vh]. Background image with a warm gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FAF9F6]/90 to-[#FAF9F6]/20). Show '안녕하세요' (Korean hello) as a small elegant badge above the H1.
components.services_cards: Minimalist cards, rounded-2xl, bg-[#F5F2EA] or white. Soft hover effect (translate-y-[-4px] and slightly stronger shadow).
components.buttons: Primary: Solid gold (bg-[#D4AF37] text-white) with soft glow. Secondary: Outline gold (border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37]). Rounded-full for organic feel.
components.booking_form: Clean Shadcn inputs customized with border-[#E5E1D8] and focus:ring-[#D4AF37]. Use select for service type, native date/time for simplicity if Shadcn calendar is heavy, but Shadcn is preferred.

logo.description: CLA Aesthetics & Wellness Main Logo (Gold laurel wreath)

hero_bg.description: High-end editorial photograph of a serene spa treatment room, golden light.

texture_bg.description: Abstract texture of ivory silk and warm beige stones for section backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Cormorant Garamond and Outfit fonts from Google Fonts.
Build a single-page site with smooth scrolling (react-scroll or standard anchor links).
Ensure the hero section uses the hero_bg image with a delicate gradient overlay, placing the '안녕하세요' badge and H1 prominently.
Create an 'About' section focusing on the founder with a portrait placeholder or texture image if no portrait is provided.
Implement a bento grid or masonry layout for the Services and Portfolio sections. Use the provided gallery images.
Build a sophisticated booking form with Shadcn components (inputs, select, date picker).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
Maintain a highly spacious, low-contrast UI. Never use pure black or neon colors.
Use Lucide React for elegant, thin-line icons (strokeWidth={1.5}).
